source: World Bank Open Data API (SP.POP.TOTL, NY.GDP.PCAP.CD, SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS, EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS, IT.NET.USER.ZS, IT.CEL.SETS.P2) + UN World Urbanization Prospects 2018 + CIA World Factbook (religion/govt/colonial)
year: 2023 (electricity 2022; Myanmar internet 2020 due to data blackout)

indicator_codes.top_city_pop_pct: UN WUP 2018 / national statistics (largest city population / national total)

VN.notes: Ho Chi Minh City ~9.3M of 100M. Bipolar urban structure (HCMC + Hanoi) reduces primate-city concentration. State-led digital push (resolution 52, Make in Vietnam).

ID.notes: Jakarta ~10.6M of 281M = low primacy due to archipelago dispersion. New capital Nusantara under construction (Borneo). 17,000 islands = unique geographic fragility.

PH.notes: Metro Manila ~13.8M of 115M. Typhoon belt + Pacific Ring of Fire = highest natural disaster exposure in ASEAN. English fluency from US legacy = BPO hub.

TH.colonial: Never colonized (buffer state between French Indochina and British Burma/Malaya)
TH.notes: Bangkok ~11M of 72M = high primacy. Aging society (median age 40+). PromptPay = mobile-money success but card/cash legacy strong.

MY.notes: Greater KL ~8.5M of 35M. Multi-ethnic (Malay/Chinese/Indian) + bumiputera policy. Petronas oil rents = middle-income trap risk.

SG.religion_majority: No majority (Buddhist 31% / Christian 19% / Muslim 16% / None 20% / Hindu 5%)
SG.colonial: British (Straits Settlements 1819-1963, then brief Malaysia federation)
SG.notes: City-state = trivially 100% primacy. Highest GDP/capita in ASEAN. Reference benchmark for digital governance (Singpass, PayNow).

KH.govt_system: Constitutional monarchy (de facto one-party, CPP / Hun family dynasty)
KH.notes: Phnom Penh ~2.2M of 17M. Post-Khmer Rouge trauma + young population. Bakong CBDC = pioneer in ASEAN. Chinese investment heavy (Sihanoukville).

LA.notes: Vientiane ~0.95M of 7.7M. Landlocked. Hydropower export to TH/VN/CN. Debt distress to China. Mobile penetration LOWEST in ASEAN (65/100) = anomaly.

MM.govt_system: Military junta (2021 coup, civil war ongoing)
MM.notes: Yangon ~5.7M of 54M. Internet 2020 value (post-coup blackouts make 2023 data unreliable). Lowest electricity access in ASEAN. Active civil war = data quality caveat.

BN.govt_system: Absolute monarchy (Sultanate, oldest royal lineage in SEA)
BN.notes: Bandar Seri Begawan ~66k of 459k. Oil/gas rents = high GDP/capita without industrialization. Tiny sample but useful outlier (rent-state).

hypotheses.title: 都市集中度(top_city_pop_pct)が高い国ほど災害・パンデミック脆弱性が高い
hypotheses.reasoning: TH(15.3), MY(24.2), PH(12.0)のような首都一極集中型は、災害・サプライチェーン途絶で全国機能が止まる。ID(3.7)・VN(9.3)のような多極分散型は冗長性が高い。SGはcity-stateで例外。
hypotheses.testable_with: 災害死者数(EM-DAT)、COVID経済ショック幅、Logistics Performance Index

hypotheses.title: 植民地経路で現代インフラ・行政の初期条件が決まる
hypotheses.reasoning: British圏(MY,SG,MM,BN)=common law + 鉄道網。French圏(VN,KH,LA)=中央集権官僚制 + メートル法。Dutch(ID)=分権連邦型。Spanish-US(PH)=英語+カトリック+米国式大統領制。Never-colonized(TH)=独自軍政循環。internet/mobile普及度と相関するか。
hypotheses.testable_with: internet_pct, mobile_per_100, World Bank Governance Indicators, English proficiency (EF EPI)
hypotheses.expected_correlation: British/Dutch圏 > French圏 (法整備の連続性)

hypotheses.title: 電気アクセス率が100%でもモバイルマネー普及が遅い国はlegacy(現金/カード)に縛られている
hypotheses.reasoning: TH(電100%/mobile169)・MY(電100%/mobile143)は物理インフラ完成済みだが、銀行・カード網が先に整備されたためQR/wallet移行に摩擦。一方KH(電92%/mobile121)・VN(電100%/mobile131)はleapfrog型。LA(電100%/mobile65)は両方未成熟で唯一の異常値。
hypotheses.testable_with: GSMA Mobile Money State Report, BIS Triennial Survey, 各国中銀のe-payment統計

hypotheses.title: 宗教多数派とリープフロッグ強度の関係
hypotheses.reasoning: イスラム圏(ID, MY, BN)はsharia-compliant fintech(takaful, sukuk)が独自発展。仏教圏(TH, KH, LA, MM, VN)は寺院送金・コミュニティ信用が現代mobile moneyのソーシャル基盤に。カトリック圏(PH)は海外出稼ぎ送金需要→GCash/Maya急成長。宗教は単なる文化変数ではなく金融プロダクト設計の制約条件。
hypotheses.testable_with: Islamic Finance Development Indicator, OFW remittance flows (BSP), mobile money active users per religion
hypotheses.expected_correlation: religion is moderator, not direct driver

hypotheses.title: 体制(民主度・透明性)とデータ品質・捕捉率
hypotheses.reasoning: MM(軍政)・LA(一党制)・KH(事実上一党)・VN(一党制)では公式統計の精度に懸念。SG・MY・ID・PHの数値と直接比較するときバイアスを意識。脆弱性分析では複数ソース(NGO/衛星/民間)の併用が必須。
hypotheses.testable_with: V-Dem Liberal Democracy Index, World Bank Statistical Capacity Index, Freedom House
